description: Enable or disable Ads Watch for the account. To enable, quote first with soclo_ads_watch_read or an unconfirmed enable request, show the exact monthlyCredits and renewal terms, and obtain owner approval before confirm:true. Enabling within an existing paid period charges nothing now; otherwise it charges the quoted price now. Renewal charges that price every 30 days until disabled. Disabling applies immediately and spends nothing. Pass expectedStateHash from the read and retain clientRequestId. After uncertainty read current state; never retry automatically. Full field guide: soclo://tools/soclo_ads_watch_set.
name: soclo_ads_watch_set
title: Enable or disable Ads Watch
